summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf (all/default accept_redirects=0, all/default accept_source_route=0). Applied live and verified survival across a full node reboot (boot_id changed from bf4e9cbb-84f9-45f0-9b81-6602b98cea07 to ea140a49-71f2-473f-ad64-5f0f3940cfc1).
actions_performed: Captured baseline sysctl values and boot_id on node1 (accept_redirects=1, accept_source_route=0)
Checked for pre-existing sysctl.d/sysctl.conf entries for these keys (none found)
Applied via sudo sysctl --system and confirmed live kernel values changed
Set live per-interface values (enp1s0, lo) to 0 for accept_redirects to eliminate stale pre-existing interface state
Captured pre-restart boot_id, issued sudo systemctl reboot, polled until node1 became reachable again
Verified boot_id changed (proving an actual restart occurred) and re-checked sysctl values, per-interface values, and the persisted config file post-reboot

evidence.requirement: Baseline healthy state before restart (current accept_redirects/accept_source_route values and boot identity)
evidence.summary: Captured initial sysctl values (accept_redirects=1, accept_source_route=0) and boot_id bf4e9cbb-84f9-45f0-9b81-6602b98cea07 before any change
Confirmed no existing sysctl.conf/sysctl.d entries for accept_redirects or accept_source_route

evidence.requirement: Persistent config file created and applied
evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf and applied with sysctl --system; output shows all/default accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0 took effect

evidence.requirement: Live kernel state fully consistent across interfaces before restart
evidence.summary: Per-interface /proc/sys checks showed enp1s0/lo accept_redirects still 1 after sysctl --system (stale pre-existing interface state); explicitly set enp1s0 and lo accept_redirects=0 live and reconfirmed all/default/source_route values

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart boot identity captured immediately before reboot
evidence.summary: Re-confirmed boot_id bf4e9cbb-84f9-45f0-9b81-6602b98cea07 unchanged just before issuing reboot
systemctl reboot issued; exec stream closed as expected, confirming the reboot command was accepted and the node went down

evidence.requirement: Node restart occurred (changed boot identity) and command execution recovered
evidence.summary: Polled node1 through connection timeouts/reset during reboot until reachable again; boot_id read as ea140a49-71f2-473f-ad64-5f0f3940cfc1, proving a genuine restart occurred (differs from pre-restart bf4e9cbb...)

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery and persistence of the hardening settings
evidence.summary: After reboot, sysctl shows all/default accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0, enp1s0 accept_redirects=0/accept_source_route=0, and the /etc/sysctl.d config file is intact — confirming the settings persisted across the restart
